commands.asyncNote: Note: Configuration, upload and firmware commands run in the background on the device. "Delivered" means the command reached the device; completion depends on the device and may take time. For some commands the device may briefly close the modem/link to process it (FTP download/upload); a temporary "offline" state during this is normal and the device reconnects when done.
